title: Non-Invasive Characterization of Focal Liver Lesions in Liver Cirrhosis
official: Non-Invasive Characterization of Focal Liver Lesions in Liver Cirrhosis
summary: This study aims to analyze non-invasive characterization focal liver lesions in patients with liver cirrhosis. The diagnostic accuracy and predictive value of non-invasive methods is studied.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all patients with focal liver lesions and liver cirrhosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* no consent
* under 18 years
